writing.title: Placeholder Teddy
writing.author: Madhur Budhwani
writing.heading: A marriage. A promise. A life she never imagined.
writing.summary: Ananya wants the ordinary magic of companionship: late-night ice cream, random drives, and someone to call her person. An arranged match with Aarav seems to offer that future. But behind a wealthy family's carefully composed welcome, marriage holds secrets she never thought to ask about.

design.title: SAMVID '17 — Cultural Fest
design.note: Cultural-events master poster. Fiery winged emblem anchors the composition; performance silhouettes and bold orange type introduce eight cultural events in a two-column grid.

design.title: Festa D'Addio — Farewell Party
design.note: Farewell poster for CSE 6th. Neon hexagon frame over a cosmic backdrop, silhouette group under a city skyline, and layered micro-copy ('same people, brighter tomorrows' / 'goodbyes create bigger stories') that turns a single poster into a full farewell narrative.

design.title: SAMVID '17 — Model Making & My Innovation
design.note: Technical-event poster with hanging light-bulbs cascading over a deep-blue field. Gold neon type and a categorised registration grid ground the composition.

design.title: Rathi Consultancy — Business Card
design.note: Two-sided business card for a civil-engineering consultancy. Front: blueprint fragment with a monogram crest and services list. Back: wireframe city panorama with tagline 'You Dream It, We build It.' A brand system, not a one-off poster.

design.title: SAMVID '17 — Singing Star
design.note: Solo-round singing competition poster. Ethereal blue backdrop with a silhouetted performer, glowing script wordmark, and a clean two-column info bar for entry rules and contacts.

design.title: SAMVID '17 — Technical Events
design.note: Master poster for the technical arm of SAMVID '17. Ten events rendered as metallic gears in a clean grid, sidebar list on the left, unified silver/blue/black palette. Restraint over spectacle.

design.title: SAMVID '17 — Treasure Hunt
design.note: Event poster styled as an aged treasure map with a lantern, compass, and a dashed trail linking Round 1 (Treasure Hunt) to Round 2 (Scavenger Hunt). Tolkien-tinged tagline: 'not all those who wander are lost.'

design.title: The Trippy Monk
design.note: Character illustration. Serene monk in lotus pose against a psychedelic mandala backdrop, sun and moon in the sky, kaleidoscope patterns filling the sunglasses. Personal work.
